UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Represents a registered merchant or administrator account managed by the platform owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account holder.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

displayName.description: Full name of the user or account manager.

contactInfo.description: Phone, WhatsApp, or Telegram contact handle.

role.description: Access control role assigned by the platform owner.

accountStatus.description: Approval and subscription status controlled by the owner.

planTier.description: Subscription tier assigned to the account.

subscriptionEndsAt.description: ISO date string or label indicating when the subscription expires.

notes.description: Owner administrative notes about the subscriber.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was last updated.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator lookup document managed exclusively by the platform owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

grantedBy.description: UID of the owner who granted admin access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user and merchant accounts, subscription status, and role permissions.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted registry of administrator UIDs managed by the platform owner.
